dialogues.speaker: Vinkel
dialogues.text: Greetings! How may I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to learn about "Across the Wilderness."

dialogues.speaker: Vinkel
dialogues.text: "Across the Wilderness" is a fun event held by the Adventurers' Guild, aiming to test the adventurers' strength in various aspects!

dialogues.speaker: Vinkel
dialogues.text: During the event, the participating adventurers need to find the Wilderness Balloons according to the prompts and venture forward following the distribution of those balloons.

dialogues.speaker: Vinkel
dialogues.text: The more Wilderness Balloons one collects within the time limit, the higher the rating and the greater the rewards will be.

dialogues.speaker: Vinkel
dialogues.text: Alright! Please do come and participate in the event!
